1. HyperNex Genomics -- spencer.powell@gmail.com

3. NexaLink Dynamics -- jamie-solomon@gmail.com
4. QuantumVerse Analytics -- kat_simp@gmail.com
5. NanoFlex Systems -- ma_smith@gmail.com

The resume is at: /home/alexander/documents/work/resume.pdf

Now let me send the emails. I'll send them all at once since they're independent.

For each company, I need to replace {company_name} in the template with the actual company name.
